arabic_policy.pdf#s0.section: سياسة العمل عن بعد - شركة نبض تك
arabic_policy.pdf#s0.text:
يسمح للموظفين بالعمل عن بعد لمدة يومين في الأسبوع كحد أقصى. يجب الحصول على موافقة المدير المباشر قبل العمل عن بعد. تتحمل الشركة تكلفة الإنترنت بقيمة 20 دينارا شهريا.

يجب أن يكون الموظف متاحا خلال ساعات العمل الأساسية.

employee_handbook.pdf#s0.text: Core working hours are 9:00 to 17:00, Sunday to Thursday. Employees may work remotely up to 2 days per week with manager approval.

employee_handbook.pdf#s1.text: Full-time employees receive 21 days of paid annual leave per year. After 5 years of service this increases to 28 days. Unused leave of up to 7 days may be carried over to the next year.

employee_handbook.pdf#s3.section: **Nabd Tech Employee Handbook 2026** > **3. Salary Bands** > **4. Training Budget**
employee_handbook.pdf#s3.text: Each employee has an annual training budget of 500 JOD for courses, certifications and conferences. Requests go to the HR portal at least 14 days before the event.

expense_policy.docx#s0.text:
Nabd Tech Expense Policy

All business expenses must be submitted within 30 days with a receipt. Expenses above 200 JOD require approval from the department head.

it_faq.html#s0.section: Nabd Tech IT FAQ > How do I reset my password?
it_faq.html#s0.text: Go to sso.nabd.example and click "Forgot password". Passwords expire every 90 days.

it_faq.html#s1.section: Nabd Tech IT FAQ > What is the Wi-Fi network?
it_faq.html#s1.text: Staff use NABD-STAFF. Guests use NABD-GUEST, which is valid for 24 hours.

it_faq.html#s2.section: Nabd Tech IT FAQ > Who do I contact for laptop issues?
it_faq.html#s2.text: Open a ticket at helpdesk.nabd.example or call extension 4200.
